mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND campaign_id=#{campaign}
SELECT FROM marketing_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} ORDER BY campaign_id
SELECT FROM marketing_execution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id>#{after} ORDER BY order_id,campaign_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_execution SET status=IF(grant_id IS NULL,'APPLIED','GRANT_REQUESTED'),lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND campaign_id=#{campaign} AND status='RESERVED'
UPDATE marketing_execution SET status='RELEASED',lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND campaign_id=#{campaign} AND status='RESERVED'
UPDATE marketing_execution SET status='GRANTED',lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} AND grant_id=#{grant} AND status='GRANT_REQUESTED'
